title: Von Braun's deathbed warning about a staged alien threat
summary: Steven Greer tells of Von Braun's deathbed warning about a staged alien threat, about 1977 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the card they want to play that Veron Brown warned about on his deathbed to my friend Carol Rosen was they want to create an alien threat to unite the world
And Warner von Brown was convinced that there would be this sort of false flag because he knew when he died in 74
tellings.difference: This telling dates the warning and von Braun's death to 1974, where the story says 1977, and calls it a 'false flag'.
